title: What Should Have Happened: Kellett volna

sections.title: Should Have
sections.content: You know *kellett volna* from B1 Unit 20. The verb stands in the past, *volna* shows that it did not happen: *a szakmai testületeknek kellett volna dönteniük* means that they did not decide. The infinitive can take a personal ending: *dönteniük*.

sections.title: Whose Judgement
sections.content: A *kellett volna* sentence is always somebody's judgement, so it carries its source: *a bírálók szerint … kellett volna …*. The narrator only reports what happened.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A bírálók szerint a szakmai testületeknek kellett volna dönteniük a támogatásokról.
According to the critics, professional bodies should have decided about the funding.
A bírálók szerint a pályázatokat nyilvánosan kellett volna elbírálni.
According to the critics, the applications should have been judged in public.
The assessment of the agency was disputed.
